name: Apple AirPods 4
shortDescription: Apple AirPods 4 wireless earbuds with the H2 chip, Personalised Spatial Audio, IP54 rating and a USB-C charging case.
description:
AirPods 4 are open-fit wireless earbuds with Apple's H2 headphone chip. They support Personalised Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking, Adaptive EQ and Voice Isolation for calls.

The earbuds and case are rated IP54 for dust, sweat and water resistance, and connect over Bluetooth 5.3. The charging case uses a USB-C connector; a USB-C charge cable is not included in the box.

Apple quotes up to 5 hours of listening per charge and up to 30 hours with the case (on the Active Noise Cancellation model, with noise control off).
